title: fix(agents): avoid stale tool failure replies while waiting for children
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes misleading tool-failure replies when an agent recovers from an earlier tool error and intentionally yields to wait for a continuation.

## User Impact

A successful pause no longer presents an earlier tool error as the task's final outcome. Real failures, restart messages, and the diagnostic for yielding without a continuation remain visible.

## Why This Change Was Made

Terminal preparation omits the retained error only from reply generation when the attempt yielded and its canonical terminal status is successful. It keeps the original error for execution traces, cron execution-denial diagnostics, and safe Code Mode failure metadata. Continuation admission and scheduling are unchanged.

CI also exposed two existing fixture assumptions in the tested main context. The cold-admission fixture now clears durable clean-close integrity proof as well as its memory cache, matching sibling fixtures; the changed-lanes expectation includes the existing UI TypeScript file selected for Stylelint. These changes retain every assertion and do not change production behavior. Current main was merged while preserving the original contributor commits.

Original fix by @VACInc.

## Work sessions

- [Discussion, implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/~key/dashboard/b07573bf-65ce-4099-949f-cc6a3d82124f)
- [Regression-test implementation](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/~key/dashboard/1f3d2b1b-3845-4cff-ab35-eaf23c81bab9)

## Evidence

Merged through the native workflow as [ee54e47ac081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ee54e47ac0815028d475557f6ab82377414782f1).

The original Linux session trace established the pre-fix stale warning and a later child-triggered continuation. That observation did not prove the repaired behavior or general follow-through.

- Eight new cases exercise the real payload builder and terminal resolution: clean yield with/without continuation, ordinary failure, failed/timed-out yield, restart presentation, and preserved cron/Code Mode diagnostics.
- Before/after proof: reverting only the production fix makes both clean-yield cases fail with the stale `Exec failed` payload; restoring the fix passes all eight cases. The new suite plus terminal-preparation and terminal-resolution siblings passes **98 tests**.
- [Secretless AWS proof](https://crabbox.openclaw.ai/portal/runs/run_2d6cdce4c3373d8b758645daf2b1b561): the test/check command completed with exit 0 on pinned original head `87cfd386144fc69d503d0865d9baab4020699c7a` plus the exact regression file published in `5578a8c58dac232e4165dc697980ef8d0f3f003a`. All changed-file checks passed, including formatting, production/test typechecks, lint, dead-export scans, and repository guards. The Crabbox client later exited 7 after a broker event timeout; authoritative completion reporting remained unavailable, but lease release and host removal were confirmed during closeout. This is a control-plane limitation, not a claim that the runner invocation succeeded end to end.
- Independent whole-candidate autoreview through P3 completed with no actionable findings. No hostile behavior was identified in the reviewed changes.
- CI-fixture verification on trusted main `305b0349dd8d2126534c9e3993a49c81cc10144f` with the two fixture corrections, using CI's Node 24.19.0: **408 tests passed** (352 changed-lanes tests and 56 archive/eviction/prepared-admission tests). The Stylelint assertion reproduced before correction. The historical archive CI failure did not reproduce in standalone/full-file local baseline runs; its incomplete cold-state reset was established from the cache-owner contract and existing sibling fixtures, without claiming a reproduced timing failure.
- The integrated four-file candidate received a fresh, clean whole-candidate P3 autoreview. Required CI and ClawSweeper review are bound to the latest PR head; their current outcomes are shown in the checks and durable review comment.
- [Full CI on `e02ec3ae26663c9d5b624d3f3825dd34d4dac0e7`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35533653333) completed successfully: 177 jobs reconciled, with 160 successful and 17 skipped by the workflow's scoped/native/live-job conditions. No failed or unfinished CI jobs remained. The required status was published as SUCCESS by the normal publisher retry after its installation quota recovered; no required status was manually set or bypassed.
- No live Gateway deployment, restart, or Telegram E2E is claimed; behavioral proof covers the actual preparation/resolution boundary in isolation.
